SNS・note（note・本文）.quote: Airbus and CNES Complete TELEO Optical Link Demonstration｜Fratta
Airbus and CNES Complete TELEO Optical Link Demonstration
French National Centre for Space Studies (CNES)
have completed the TELEO mission, which demonstrates ultra-high throughput laser communication between geostationary orbit (GEO) and Earth. TELEO is an optical communication payload carried on the
Badr-8 communications satellite.

According to CNES, TELEO demonstrated a reliable link with a prototype ground station called FrOGS (French Optical Ground Station) under a wide range of conditions, proving bidirectional laser transmission of up to 9 Gbps. The demonstration experiments between TELEO and FrOGS lasted for 22 days, with over 60 hours of active communication.

"Laser communication with space will reshape the communications market, just as fiber optics changed terrestrial communications," commented Philippe Pham, Head of Telecom and Navigation Systems at Airbus. "TELEO is the next generation of laser satellite communication, demonstrating extremely high-speed and resilient connectivity from Earth orbit to the ground."

A joint test campaign with the European Space Agency (ESA), ONERA, and the French Defence Innovation Agency was conducted across Europe. The first communication link was achieved at various data rates by the Airbus ground station team in the Netherlands, utilizing ESA's existing ground facility in Tenerife, Spain.

CNESによると、TELEOSは幅広い条件下でFrOGS（フランス光地上局）と呼ばれるプロトタイプの地上局との信頼性の高いリンクを実証し、最大9Gbpsの双方向レーザー伝送を実証しました。TELEOとFrOGS間の実証実験は22日間続き、60時間以上のアクティブ通信が行われました。
